name: psd_ai
description: Connect Codex to a scoped psd.ai instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped psd.ai tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to psd.ai through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so psd.ai Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use psd.ai only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
